name: TruePlanet
author: Xm0x
description: Seeded spherical planets with a real rotatable globe, optional flat map and native translucent floating controls. Nations, political provinces, settlements and solid orange roads share persistent playable geographic tiles, including wilderness. Standard/Detailed resolution and fixed local map size. Explicit single-scene travel saves native snapshots and carries campaign currencies/skill progression; local worlds remain separate. Original legacy province saves remain readable. Requires RuinarchModLoader 0.9.0. No Travel Portal structures, offscreen simulation or seamless streaming.
